_doc: Paraphrase-robustness set. Each group is ONE question a user actually has, written the several ways a real user writes it. A benchmark measures whether the system can answer a question; this measures whether it answers the SAME question the same way regardless of wording — which is what decides whether a pilot survives contact with real users. Golds for tenant_1 groups are exact figures computed from analytics.duckdb (see tests/eval/README_paraphrase.md for the SQL), not hand-judged.
_ground_truth_source: tenant_1 analytics.duckdb: 369 students, 35 FAIL (9.5%), 334 PASS (90.5%), 16 students with >=2 subject failures, 12 with >=3, 89 with SGPA >= 8, BTCOC502 is the most-failed subject (16).
